department: Doctoral Program in Computational and Quantitative Biology (EDCB)

deadline.value: Deadlines March 31 and November 1. Next for Fall 2027: November 1, 2026 (year inferred).
deadline.quote: before the application deadline (March 31st or November 1st).

gre_general.value: EDCB recommends GRE results; explain in the application if you skip it.
gre_general.quote: We recommend that EDCB candidates provide us with the results of their GRE test.

supervisor.value: Emailing the heads of labs you like is strongly recommended to help matching at the Hiring Days.
supervisor.quote: we STRONGLY recommend that you contact by email the head of the lab(s) you are interested in before or while you apply.

funding.value: Enrolment requires secure funding, so admitted students are funded (typically as salaried EPFL doctoral assistants).
funding.quote: The final enrollment in the doctoral program is conditional to the choice of a thesis topic, a supervisor and a secure funding.

also.quote: The basic starting salary of an EPFL doctoral assistant is CHF 55’225.- gross per annum

entry_route.value: A master's or equivalent with a strong quantitative background; a 4-year bachelor's may be considered.
entry_route.quote: Eligible candidates must have a Masters Degree or equivalent.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Closest Atlas field is biomedical sciences; the program is quantitative/computational biology.
